svg.title: Freight forwarder — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as freight forwarder, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A long horizontal ribbed shipping container sits below a separate shipment manifest with two entry lines. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: short hair, a rounded face.
